blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — A 12-year-old girl who had been missing for three days was found dead in a grassy area in Barangay Singcang-Airport, Bacolod City, on Friday evening, Nov. 27, while a man suspected of killing her was arrested. Personnel of Bacolod City Police Office (BCPO) Station 8, led by officer-in-charge Capt. Francis Depasucat, arrived at the area at around 6:50 p.m. Friday after receiving reports of a body found in the vicinity. Initial police investigation showed that the victim was reported missing since Wednesday, Nov. 25. She was last seen riding a tricycle driven by the suspect, identified only as […]...
